changelog:
Goober Hub profiles, activity feed, friends-only messages, clans and Passport.
Share outfits, editor stamps and compatible TAS macros, with animated outfit previews.
Editor stamps with placement previews, native Editor+ integration and expanded transform/group/layer controls.
Advanced: TAS workflow options, frame input editing, live rewind/forward and trajectory death preview.
33 new themes, theme folders and refined new/Block Bros scenery; older themes unchanged.
Avatar Studio in Customize, compact cosmetic cards, per-item textures and equipped-Look indicators.
Journey reward sequences, special sounds, pinned-goal/PB feedback and clearer session summaries.
Real-level finish-animation previews and subtle temporary new-reward highlighting.
Estimated XP leaderboard support and My position shortcut.
Move/scale supported interface widgets and hide Journey/Hub match buttons.
Active-time tracking and earlier-playtime XP recalculation updates.
Fixed map auto-claim and Claim All coverage.
Fixed TAS checkpoint/death/entry pause timing and native-tick capture issues.
Reduced hitbox-viewer overhead.
Fixed finish-animation tracking/camera/name-bar handling.
Smaller certified-map Journey notices.
Fixed custom body colours on the dash recharge bar.
Fixed layered weapon visibility and texture/transform shader compatibility.
Fixed repeated shared-theme selections and cooldown handling.
